messages:
alex: heads-up: we have three linked PRs blocking tomorrow's canary: SDK #4521, API #7893, Console #331. Helm chart PR #98 updates runtime image tag. Need quick approvals + merge order. Anyone on reviews?

maya: :eyes: I'm on the SDK review now. Any breaking API surface?

alex: SDK change is only an auth header rename (minor). API PR changes route param ordering — small compat risk. Console depends on the new SDK client; helm points to new image with kv-cache tweak.

jen: I can do API review, maybe in 30–45m. Will flag any breaking changes.

tom: Console lgtm after SDK merge, but I need SDK merged + npm publish so console CI is green.

priya: Helm side: runtime image bump passes unit tests but integration fails with intermittent 503/timeouts. Might be readiness probe or slower warmup from kv-cache.

alex: Noted. Priya, can you check readiness probe? If it's flaky, fallback to previous tag and we add healthprobe change in a follow-up.

priya: I'll try adjusting readiness to 20s and re-run. If still flaky, revert to previous tag.

ci-bot: CI: SDK #4521 — tests passed :white_check_mark:

maya: Reviewed SDK, left two comments about header rename docs. Approve pending doc fixes.

alex: Can we do this ordering: merge SDK -> publish -> merge API -> merge Console -> helm bump? Need approvals from Jen and Tom.

jen: I'll start API review now.

tom: :thumbsup: I'll queue console merge once SDK published. ETA ~1h.

priya: Helm retest queued.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy queued (canary window 11:00-13:00 UTC).

alex: If approvals come in, can we aim to merge between 10:30-11:15 so canary catches it?

maya: I can make doc fixes quickly; ping me when SDK merged.

jen: API has one minor nit, left a comment. Otherwise approve.

jen: Approving API #7893.

tom: SDK published 1.2.4 :tada:

tom: Merging console now.

ci-bot: Console #331 — build failed (flaky snapshot).

tom: Rerunning CI.

ci-bot: Console #331 — build passed :white_check_mark:

tom: Merged console and created release candidate.

priya: Helm retest: still flaky on readiness. Changing probe to 25s helped. Will open follow-up PR to tune autoscaling/probes.

alex: Okay, we'll hold helm bump for later today. For canary, runtime will use previous tag so release isn't blocked.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started at 11:05 UTC.

ci-bot: Staging smoke tests — all green.

maya: Docs PR merged.

alex: :shipit: Thanks all. If anything breaks, roll back to previous tag; Tom and Priya are on call for 2h.

maya: :party: good run!
